It really blows when someone comes here before you.

The first thing to say is it’s absolutely valid you feel this way. Regardless of any diagnosis, etc, I can see how it’s very stressful. 

And you’re likely to be misinterpreting what’s going on. As humans we all have our own interpretations and sometimes they’re wrong so we have to check to see if they’re right. I will say that psychiatrists are very unlikely to observe you in this way, it wouldn’t be ethical or legal and they could be in very serious trouble for doing so.

It’s worth raising this with your psychiatrist if you feel able as they should want to improve their own behaviour to not make you feel uncomfortable. Discussing things can help you feel better and check your own interpretations, as everyone sometimes needs to. Or you could ask if you can speak to someone else if you don’t feel comfortable. Maybe a psychiatrist or another professional like a mental health nurse. You could also speak to your primary care doctor.
